subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should the Control UI permit a sandboxed MCP App to request user-confirmed chat text under the proposed fresh-view authority model?
rationale: This changes the permanent authority boundary from a sandboxed app iframe to the visible chat composer; source-level verification is unavailable in this review environment, and maintainers must decide whether the product boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Approve the bounded bridge
options.body: Accept message requests only with exact host confirmation and after an owner independently verifies the fresh-view, visibility, command, and reconstruction guards.

options.title: Keep MCP Apps read-only
options.body: Defer the messaging capability and land only non-authority host-context updates if maintainers do not want iframe-to-chat delegation.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded bridge
recommendation.body: Accept message requests only with exact host confirmation and after an owner independently verifies the fresh-view, visibility, command, and reconstruction guards.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this person as the active contributor on the proposed MCP App bridge, though a current-main ownership search remains necessary.
